cand.title: Superlab Suisse
cand.excerpt: New facility provides private/shared labs, scientific equipment and operational support; move-in was planned for January 2026.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Alexandra Martiné, MSc — Director of BD & Operations Geneva, verified on the official contact page; strongest local relationship-development contact for visitor requirements and internal referral. Xi Zhang — Founder & CEO, verified in an official programme; relevant executive sponsor for a network-level relationship. Neither is verified as a hotel contract signatory or accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: No next Geneva Demo Day or Geneva facility-opening edition with exact dates and venue was found officially announced for 7 December 2026–30 June 2028. The seed referred to planned January 2026 laboratory move-in, not a future conference. Later primary evidence places the laboratory launch in May 2026. A separately organized FONGIT Life Sciences Café+Croissant is announced for 1 December 2026 at B4, Campus Biotech, Geneva, but precedes the requested horizon and is not a repeat facility opening or Demo Day.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel product: conditional, secondary-territory fit for visiting tenant/project teams or a deliberately off-site corporate workshop, not an established event block. A 237-room Founex hotel with six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre capacity could serve an appropriately sized brief, but the demonstrated Geneva events are campus-based morning programmes. No evidence establishes overnight need, Founex acceptance or transfers. This is a city-linked project relationship, not a resort congress opportunity; Lausanne activity should not be counted without proven booking/transfer evidence.
findings.venueCommitments: Confirmed operating facility: Superlab Suisse Geneva SA, B4 building, Campus Biotech, Chemin des Mines 9, 1202 Genève, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva city, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or the Geneva Airport corridor. The 18 March 2026 Demo Day used the B4 Amphitheater; FONGIT lists its B4 event entrance as Rue Kazem-Radjavi 5. These are campus commitments, not hotel commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: This is expansion of a laboratory network, not demonstrated destination rotation of one event series. Geneva Demo Day took place on 18 March 2026 at Campus Biotech, including lab previews. The laboratory launch is reported as May 2026; the exact operational opening day remains unverified. FONGIT held a distinct collaborative Café+Croissant at B4 on 17 September 2026. No annual Geneva Demo Day recurrence is verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No housing bureau, hotel RFP, edition-specific room block, incumbent hotel or peak-room commitment was identified in the reviewed Geneva facility, Demo Day or FONGIT event materials. Hotels listed for Geneva lodging: none in those materials. The Demo Day registration page states: “Registration Closed” and “Location: Campus Biotech, Geneva Time: 09:00–12:00 Parking: P+R Sécheron”. These describe participation and access, not lodging procurement; silence does not establish open hotel sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Superlab Suisse is a commercial ready-to-move-in laboratory and operational-services provider; the local entity is Superlab Suisse Geneva SA. Campus Biotech is the facility/venue, not an identified hotel buyer. Superlab organized its Geneva Demo Day. FONGIT is the organizer of the separate Life Sciences Café+Croissant programme, with Superlab collaboration explicitly documented for September. No PCO, DMC or housing agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Campus Biotech B4 already offers meeting rooms, community space and an auditorium, creating an incumbent on-site meeting alternative. Its city location and the short event format weaken an off-site Founex lodging thesis; this is inference, not verified hotel competition. No competing hotel, sold-out inventory or overflow evidence was found. Historical attendance is not room demand, and there is no basis to claim a 20–120-room block or the entire hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Alexandra Martiné through the official Geneva contact channel first; ask whether visiting tenants, suppliers, investors or project teams require paid overnight stays, who books and pays, incumbent hotels, travel origins, stay lengths and acceptable Founex transport arrangements. Request a specific 2027–June 2028 meeting/visitor brief before pricing or holding rooms. Ask for referral to Xi Zhang only if a network-level agreement is relevant. Keep the account in relationship-development status unless dated, quantified demand and an accessible procurement path are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The March Demo Day, May facility launch and September collaborative event are past. The 1 December 2026 FONGIT event is upcoming as of 16 November, with registration closing 27 November at 10:00, but is outside the requested horizon. It could be a relationship-development touchpoint only; its venue is already B4 and no accommodation procurement is published. The operating laboratory account is approachable, but no current hotel tender is verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue a low-priority, needs-led corporate/project relationship rather than a qualified future event capture. Potential paths are visiting scientific/commercial teams, tenant onboarding or an intentionally off-site workshop. Existing campus meeting infrastructure limits automatic venue displacement. Do not infer an annual Demo Day, a future opening edition, hotel overflow or regional room nights from the laboratory network.
